title: Zombie Films
subtitle: the walking dead on film, era by era
blurb: 609 zombie features with a Wikipedia page to their name, from the voodoo pictures to the streaming wave. No order — let the picker choose.
notes: A grab bag by design — nothing leads anywhere, a 60-minute cheapie counts the same as a two-hour epic, and the Pick-one button is the intended front door.
Wikipedia's list carries hundreds of entries with no article behind them; only the verifiable ones got rows. Shorts live on Wikipedia's separate shorts list and are not here.
From Wikipedia's List of zombie films; runtimes from Wikidata where they exist.
